items.text: Modular Kitchen configurator - build custom kitchens with cabinets, appliances, segments and material presets, including automatic snapping and edge-conforming geometry.
Camera rails for cinematic video captures, powered by a dedicated Movie Render Manager.
StyleMatch integration - connect a StyleMatch account directly from Unlit Studio to exchange interior passports and visualizations.
Bommel Wonen chair configurator, plus separate table-top configurators for Bommel Wonen and Dyyk.
New post-processing outline pass for clearer object highlighting.
15+ new brands and collections added, including Toppoint, Anvia, Zolare, Pode, Leolux, Holland Haag, Pastoe, Floer, Werk aan de Muur, Montis, Het Anker, Deponti Overkappingen and Eijffinger.
Reworked procedural "legged furniture" classes powering the new Modular Kitchen and table configurators.
Added keyboard hotkeys for faster scene navigation.
Refreshed materials and thumbnails across several brands (Toppoint, Floer, Trendhopper) for more accurate previews.
Fixed camera collisions with procedural meshes, awning rotation on rotated walls, and a mesh-mirroring performance issue.
Fixed the tile pattern option being limited to the Pro tier - it's now available in all versions.
Fixed a duplication bug in procedural curtains.
Fixed missing meshes and asset redirectors affecting several brand imports.
